snippet.title: He Who Watches trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
A first person puzzle game about walking on walls, manipulating gravity, and discovering secrets. Delve deep into a labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking the god at the centre of it all.

Check out this exclusive trailer for He Who Watches, developed by Danga Games and published by @Draknek 

He Who Watches in the Thinky Games DB: https://thinkygames.com/games/he-who-watches/
He Who Watches on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070500/He_Who_Watches/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
